source_review.notes: Reviewed all ten references. Little's Law was checked against Little's primary paper/DOI metadata; bounded demand against Reactive Streams 1.0.4 and Java Flow; cancellation/pipeline behavior against the Go article; bounded async channels against Tokio; stream backpressure against current Node documentation; transport windows against RFC 9293 and RFC 9113; RPC flow control against gRPC guidance; and shedding against the Amazon Builders' Library. Nine official pages resolved successfully; the DOI resolved to publisher metadata that denied the automated fetch, so its bibliographic claim was limited to durable DOI metadata rather than inaccessible full text.

evidence: Definitions and Notation defines G=(V,E), K_e, Q_e(t), A(t), T(t), N(t), fixed-credit conservation, L=lambda W, and rho=lambda/mu with boundaries and units.
The text consistently separates offered rate lambda_o, admitted throughput lambda, sustainable service mu, average population L, and average time W.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Reviewed symbols, subscripts, time dependence, inequality directions, capacity units, cumulative counters, and long-run-average qualifications for consistency.

evidence: artifacts/snippets/CONPAR-040/report.json records consumed values 10 through 60, occupancy [2,2,2,2,2,0], four source pauses, maximum occupancy two, and six admitted/terminal items.
Independent arithmetic gives L=800 requests/s * 0.25 s=200 requests, 500 requests/s * 0.2 s=100 requests, and a capacity-100 queue filling in one second under a 100 items/s excess.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Recomputed exact stdout, per-tick queue transitions, maximum occupancy, pause count, Little's Law examples, and rate-difference example.

evidence: Each enqueue is guarded by Q_e<K_e and increments occupancy once; each dequeue requires Q_e>0 and decrements once, preserving 0<=Q_e<=K_e from an initially empty queue.
For fixed capacity, one atomic reservation transfers a unit from C_available to C_committed and one release reverses it, preserving C_total=C_available+C_committed.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The conservation arguments explicitly require exact-once reservation/release and a separate resize protocol; they are not generalized to lossy or duplicated distributed messages without sequence rules.

evidence: Reviewed empty/full queues, zero demand, variable and oversized payloads, expansion, stacked buffers, prefetch, cancellation at every ownership state, ambiguous timeout, retries, reconnection, and dynamic resize.

Reviewed sustained overload, bursts, skew, slow sinks, fan-out lag, join retention, priority starvation, thread-pool deadlock, transport/application boundary gaps, shutdown, and safety-critical shedding.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Boundary review covers both safety bounds and liveness when capacity is exhausted, including failure and recovery paths.

evidence: Every admitted item has one owner and terminal category; queue and byte charges remain within declared capacity; credits are issued, consumed, and returned exactly once.
Admission precedes costly ownership, peer-needed resources are not held across capacity waits, overload semantics are typed, and shutdown reconciles items, credit, edges, and stage joins.
invariant_checking.notes: Checked invariants across admission, queueing, dequeue, processing, expansion, completion, rejection, discard, cancel, retry, reconnect, drain, and shutdown.

evidence: The bounded-occupancy induction has base Q=0 and guarded enqueue/dequeue transitions that cannot cross zero or K.
The permanent-rate-mismatch argument observes that finite capacity K absorbs a positive excess lambda-mu only for finite time K/(lambda-mu), after which admission must change or overflow.
proof_review.notes: Proof arguments are scoped to declared units, atomic logical transitions, stable rate assumptions, and finite capacity; no scheduler or distributed-delivery theorem is claimed.

evidence: Little's Law is qualified by stable long-run, conserved-population, same-boundary assumptions and explicitly excluded from percentile and transient guarantees.
The executable model limitations exclude races, byte costs, fairness, distributions, cancellation, retries, fan-out, networks, dynamic credit, effects, and cleanup.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Formal identities, invariant arguments, engineering heuristics, protocol-specific facts, empirical tests, and human safety review are distinguishable throughout.

evidence: python3 tools/verify_snippets.py CONPAR-040 passed one deterministic model with recorded interpreter version, exact stdout, empty stderr, and exit code zero.
The chapter requires measured service distributions, high-water marks, age, demand, pause duration, saturation, recovery, and fault injection for production claims.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: The executable trace demonstrates one sequential count-bound schedule only; it is not represented as throughput, memory, fairness, liveness, network, or deployment evidence.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed capacity budgets, sustainable rate, Little's Law, push/pull/credit, end-to-end accounting, buffer placement, admission and shedding, concurrency, cancellation/retry, wait cycles, protocol layers, observability, testing, and shutdown as one coherent ownership model.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed count/byte/multidimensional budgets, pre-admission permits, bounded task creation, retry ownership, idempotency, reserved control capacity, queue-age telemetry, transport/application separation, reconnect epochs, deterministic saturation tests, and dependency-ordered shutdown.

pedagogical_review.notes: The review sheet gives a compact retrieval model; exposition advances from local capacity to end-to-end operation; the executable trace makes pauses observable; ten examples cover distinct failure surfaces; and five exercises progress from accounting through safety-critical transfer with complete answers.

limitations: Internal authoring, source, computation, snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external queueing-theory, runtime, distributed-systems, performance, security, medical, railway, regulatory, real-time, or safety review is claimed. The teaching model establishes neither production capacity nor universal liveness, fairness, delivery, memory, timing, or safety.
